title: Crude Mace

sources.title: Concussive Smash
markers: | description = Hit an enemy with all your might to deal damage and possibly {{cond|Dazed|Daze}} them.

summary: A one-handed mace that deals 1d6 Bludgeoning and grants Concussive Smash.

fields.Concussive Smash: Action once per Short Rest with weapon proficiency. Make a melee weapon attack. On hit the target makes a Constitution save against your hybrid DC or becomes Dazed for 2 turns.
fields.Dazed: Disadvantage on Wisdom saves, no reactions that spend the Reaction resource, and no Dexterity bonus to AC. An ally can end it with Help.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details and pinned item and rules evidence.
